disposition_reason: Original ICP-MS measurements of 11 elements in 35 composite samples of retail prepared meat dishes from Zhejiang, summarized as median and quartiles with named outliers.

study.design: Retail survey of prepared (ready-to-cook) livestock and poultry meat dishes with risk assessment
study.origin: Not stated (products of 7, 5 and 11 manufacturers by category)
study.market: Supermarkets and chain stores in Hangzhou, Ningbo and Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, China (three stores per city)
study.method: ICP-MS after microwave digestion with HNO3
study.qa: SRM 1577c bovine liver and GBW10018 measured within certified ranges; RSD 1.57-15.1%

unresolved: Each of the 35 results is a composite of nine retail packages (three cities x three stores); per-dish concentrations are not tabulated except outliers named in the text.
Single-factor pollution indices (Table 6) could be multiplied by MLs to recover concentrations, but this was not done (derived).
Basis assumed as sold (homogenized edible portion); moisture not stated.
Material is a mix of chicken, pork, beef and fish dishes; results are not separated by species.
